abstract_sentences.text: Predicting the evolution of complex physical systems remains a central problem in science and engineering.

evidence.anchor: central problem in science and engineering

abstract_sentences.text: Despite rapid progress in scientific Machine Learning (ML) models, a critical bottleneck is the lack of expensive real-world data, resulting in most current models being trained and validated on simulated data.

evidence.anchor: critical bottleneck is the lack of expensive real-world data

abstract_sentences.text: Beyond limiting the development and evaluation of scientific ML, this gap also hinders research into essential tasks such as sim-to-real transfer.

evidence.anchor: this gap also hinders research into essential tasks

abstract_sentences.text: We introduce RealPDEBench, the first benchmark for scientific ML that integrates real-world measurements with paired numerical simulations.

evidence.anchor: first benchmark ... paired numerical simulations

abstract_sentences.text: RealPDEBench consists of five datasets, three tasks, nine metrics, and ten baselines.

evidence.anchor: five datasets, three tasks, nine metrics, and ten baselines

abstract_sentences.text: We first present five real-world measured datasets with paired simulated datasets across different complex physical systems.

evidence.anchor: five real-world measured datasets with paired simulated datasets

abstract_sentences.text: We further define three tasks, which allow comparisons between real-world and simulated data, and facilitate the development of methods to bridge the two.

evidence.anchor: define three tasks ... bridge the two

abstract_sentences.text: Moreover, we design nine evaluation metrics, spanning data-oriented and physics-oriented metrics, and finally benchmark ten representative baselines, including state-of-the-art models, pretrained PDE foundation models, and a traditional method.

evidence.anchor: nine evaluation metrics ... ten representative baselines

abstract_sentences.text: Experiments reveal significant discrepancies between simulated and real-world data, while showing that pretraining with simulated data consistently improves both accuracy and convergence.

evidence.anchor: significant discrepancies ... consistently improves both accuracy and convergence

abstract_sentences.text: In this work, we hope to provide insights from real-world data, advancing scientific ML toward bridging the sim-to-real gap and real-world deployment.

evidence.anchor: toward bridging the sim-to-real gap and real-world deployment

abstract_sentences.text: Our benchmark, datasets, and instructions are available at https://realpdebench.github.io/.

evidence.anchor: benchmark, datasets, and instructions are available

A OTHER EXPERIMENT RESULTS

final_judgment.single_storyline: 通过五类复杂物理场的 paired real-world／simulated data，把 scientific ML 预测固定到真实测试域，用三种训练范式和九类数据／物理指标量化 sim-to-real gap，再测试 simulated pretraining 对真实 accuracy 与 convergence 的整体价值。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 Figure 1、任务与数据角色、三训练范式、主指标、Table 1 以及 Figures 3–6 的 gap、pretraining、trade-off、long-horizon 与频带决策关键内容。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Appendix A–E 承载完整指标、horizon、频带、数据采集／校准、代码 API、mask／surrogate 与 baseline config；F 承载限制，G 承载单样本可视化，H 承载 LLM 声明。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Table 1 统一对齐五数据集、三训练范式和 baseline；Figure 3 聚合 gap／convergence／horizon，Figure 4 显式展示 RMSE–FE trade-off，附录用全表与 profile 负责审计。
final_judgment.largest_gap: “consistently” pretraining 主张受到逐格反例、无 seed／不确定性和无 controlled ablation 的限制；n、budget、OOD、deployment 未闭合，baseline 和 physics metric 还有计数歧义。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 配对测量／仿真 benchmark 应固定真实评测域，明确训练范式、分母和物理指标，并把采集处理、模态对齐、运行参数与失败边界放进可定位的附录或代码 contract。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适用于 sim-to-real benchmark 的描述性比较；不能替代 task-specific metric、independent seed／不确定性、强 OOD、组件反事实或 safety validation，也不能把点估计写成 simulation causes the gain。
